comment: Blessed from the pinned engine, hand-checked to the dollar: on a joint return the 1,678 tax (table at the 16,775 midpoint, mfj) is wiped by the child tax credit (line 24 = 0), and the refundable remainder becomes 522 of additional child tax credit = min(2,200 - 1,678; 1,700; 15% of 45,750) - LINE 33 is 6,522, the withholding plus the refundable credit. The served path where Form 8812 reaches total payments, measured. Re-blessed with the earned income credit 1,483 now computes and joins line 33 (was 6,522, now 8,005; line 34 6,522 -> 8,005) — hand-checked against the 2025 EITC table for one qualifying child: 4,328 - 15.98% x (48,275 bracket midpoint - 30,470) = 1,483. Earlier, the EITC gate facts (Form 8862, qualifying child of another) were unanswered, the chain resolved Placeholder and the credit was a placeholder 0 — the refundable-side twin of the Form 8960 understatement.
